create_TestTracker: create a TestTracker instance with an image_handle to begin body pose tracking
add_region_modality: add a RegionModality object to the TestTracker for tracking a specific body region
add_viewer: add a Viewer object to the TestTracker for visualizing tracking results
start_tracker: start the TestTracker main loop to execute tracking or viewing cycles continuously
execute_tracking_cycle: execute one tracking cycle that updates cameras, calculates correspondences, and updates pose
